_comment: Tunables that govern how fast an unattended Claude workflow spends the user's Anthropic usage budget. LOWER = SAFER (slower burn, more headroom kept in reserve). The controller (bin/recommend-pace.py) reads these; it is asymmetric — slow to scale up, fast to scale down, and fail-safe when no fresh live signal exists. Contingency reserves mean the user always keeps credit for work: the controller aims to keep usage under (100 - contingency) in each window, and hard-floors before the emergency ceilings.
